items.title: Deploy brand-facts.json to public/.well-known/
items.description: altcoinist-aeo/deliverables/brand-facts.json exists with full product data but has NEVER been copied to public/.well-known/brand-facts.json — the directory doesn't exist. AI crawlers and LLMs that look for structured brand data at /.well-known/brand-facts.json find nothing. Create public/.well-known/ and copy/symlink the deliverable there, then commit and deploy.

items.title: Fix aeo-citation-tracker timeout on first weekly run
items.description: Tracker timed out on its first run (2026-03-02). Currently tracking 15 queries — may need to reduce batch size or increase cron timeout. Measurement is broken: we can't tell if any content is moving scores without a working tracker. Check cron config for aeo-citation-tracker (id: accc997b), investigate timeout threshold, reduce queries to 10 or split into 2 batches.

items.title: Add 'safest Telegram trading bot' FAQ to telegram bots guide
items.description: Tracker: 0/10 score on 'safest Telegram trading bot' query. Even 3commas didn't score here — it's an open field. Our strongest differentiator is non-custodial self-custody (funds stay in wallet, we never touch private keys). Add a dedicated FAQ section to best-telegram-trading-bots-2026 guide: 'What is the safest Telegram trading bot?' + 'How does Altcoinist keep funds safe?' + 'Does Altcoinist store private keys?'. This is a low-effort, high-citation opportunity.

items.description: Tracker: 0 score on both 'best Telegram trading bot for Solana' AND 'best meme coin trading bot'. Altcoinist supports Solana natively + is designed for meme/micro-cap trading. No dedicated page exists for this use case. New guide: 'Best Solana Meme Coin Trading Bot 2026' targeting both queries. items.title: Audit guides for query fan-out secondary intent coverage
items.description: Ahrefs finding (2026-03-02, priority 1, unacted): AI search uses 'query fan-out' — hidden sub-queries to answer a single user question. Our guides likely answer the primary query but miss secondary intents (fees, security, chains, ease-of-use). Audit best-crypto-trading-bots-2026 and best-telegram-trading-bots-2026 for missing Q&A coverage: add FAQ sections for 'what fees does Altcoinist charge?', 'which chains?', 'is it good for beginners?', 'how fast are trades?'. Each missing answer = a sub-query we fail.
